g.text: High-pass, low-pass, or notch-filter a given EEG channel using a Chebyshev Type 2 filter (zero-phase, 60 dB stopband). The cutoff frequency of a high-
pass or low-pass filter is the frequency where the displayed signal is attenuated by 3 dB. The notch frequency is where a notch filter attenuates most; it is
3 dB down at the notch frequency ±1 Hz. A higher order gives a steeper roll-off without moving these points. Filters change the displayed signal and
therefore also the spectrogram, periodogram and time-frequency power. Click the waveform button to plot the magnitude response of a filter.
